# graph-manager skeleton: server, password login, React shell, workspace wiring

## What to build

Create the new workspace app `apps/graph-manager`. The repo is an npm-workspaces monorepo: the root `package.json` has `"workspaces": ["packages/*", "apps/*"]`, and the engine lives in `packages/graph-execution`. graph-manager is a web service around graph-execution. Later tasks add forge connections, workspaces, terminals, a runs dashboard, PR creation and a Dockerfile. This task delivers the end-to-end skeleton those tasks plug into:

- a Fastify server with config from env
- a JSON data store
- single-admin-password login with a signed session cookie
- workspace discovery helpers
- a React + Vite UI with a login page and an app shell holding placeholder pages for Workspaces, Terminals, Runs and Settings
- tests, typecheck and lint, wired into the root scripts

**Install all dependencies the later tasks need now**, so they don't each edit `package.json` and `package-lock.json` (that would cause merge conflicts).

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `package.json` (root): workspaces and the delegating scripts. `typecheck` runs `npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present`; `test` runs `npm test --workspaces --if-present`; `lint` runs `eslint .` once at the root.
- `eslint.config.js` (root): the flat config for the whole repo. Add a block for the new browser code.
- `packages/graph-execution/tsconfig.json`: the strict compiler options to copy (`strict`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `module`/`moduleResolution` `NodeNext`, `target ES2022`, `jsx react-jsx`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/web/server.ts` (lines 30-50): `readJson`, as an example of defensive request handling. Fastify parses JSON itself; validate bodies with zod.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/state/state.ts` (lines 101-111): the atomic write pattern to mirror for the data store (write `<file>.tmp`, then `rename`).
- `TESTING.md` (root): the live tester reads it. Add a graph-manager section.

## Layout to create

```
apps/graph-manager/
  package.json
  tsconfig.json            server: NodeNext, rootDir src, outDir dist, include src/server/**, exclude tests
  tsconfig.web.json        web: module ESNext, moduleResolution Bundler, lib DOM, jsx react-jsx, noEmit, include src/web/**
  vite.config.ts           root src/web, build.outDir ../../dist/web, emptyOutDir, plugin @vitejs/plugin-react
  vitest.config.ts         include src/**/*.test.ts(x), testTimeout 30000
  src/server/main.ts       entry: loadConfig(process.env) → buildApp → listen; prints "graph-manager listening on http://<host>:<port>"
  src/server/config.ts     loadConfig(env) with zod
  src/server/app.ts        buildApp(config): FastifyInstance; registers plugins and route modules
  src/server/auth.ts       session cookie sign/verify + login/logout/me routes + the auth hook
  src/server/store.ts      DataStore (JSON file in GM_DATA_DIR)
  src/server/workspaces.ts listWorkspaces / resolveWorkspace
  src/server/routes/       one file per feature, added by later tasks (create the folder with health.ts)
  src/web/index.html, main.tsx, App.tsx, api.ts, styles.css
  src/web/pages/Login.tsx, Workspaces.tsx, Terminals.tsx, Runs.tsx, RunDetail.tsx, Settings.tsx
```

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/package.json`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  ```json
  {
    "name": "graph-manager",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "private": true,
    "type": "module",
    "engines": { "node": ">=20" },
    "scripts": {
      "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build",
      "typecheck": "tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit",
      "test": "vitest run",
      "start": "node dist/server/main.js"
    }
  }
  ```
- `dependencies` (current major versions):
  - `fastify` ^5, `@fastify/cookie`, `@fastify/static`, `@fastify/websocket`
  - `zod` (same major as the engine: ^4), `execa` ^9, `node-pty` ^1
  - `graph-execution`: `"*"` (resolves to the workspace)
  - `react` ^19, `react-dom` ^19, `react-router-dom` ^7
  - `@xterm/xterm` ^5, `@xterm/addon-fit`
- `devDependencies`: `vite` ^7 (or the current major), `@vitejs/plugin-react`, `@types/react`, `@types/react-dom`, `@types/ws`, `ws`, `jsdom`, `@testing-library/react`.
- Then `npm install` at the repo root. Commit the updated root `package-lock.json`.
- **GOTCHA**:
  - `node-pty` builds natively. It needs python3, make and g++, which this machine has.
  - Later tasks must not need new packages. If you see one missing for terminals (node-pty + ws), forge HTTP (use global `fetch`) or git (execa), add it here.

### CREATE `src/server/config.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `loadConfig(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): Config` with zod.

  | Field | Env var | Default |
  |---|---|---|
  | `password` | `GM_PASSWORD` | required, non-empty |
  | `port` | `GM_PORT` | 7420 |
  | `host` | `GM_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` |
  | `dataDir` | `GM_DATA_DIR` | `path.join(os.homedir(), ".graph-manager")` |
  | `workspacesDir` | `GM_WORKSPACES_DIR` | `path.join(os.homedir(), "graph-manager-workspaces")` |
  | `githubApiUrl` | `GM_GITHUB_API_URL` | `https://api.github.com` |
  | `graphExecutionBin` | `GM_GRAPH_EXECUTION_BIN` | resolved below |

- `graphExecutionBin` resolves `fileURLToPath(import.meta.resolve("graph-execution/package.json"))` and joins `dist/cli.js` next to it. If that throws, fall back to the string `graph-execution` (on PATH).
- Missing `GM_PASSWORD` throws `ConfigError("GM_PASSWORD is required")`. `main.ts` prints it and exits 1.
- Create `dataDir` and `workspacesDir` with `mkdir -p` in `main.ts`, not in `loadConfig`.

### CREATE `src/server/store.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `class DataStore { static async open(dataDir): Promise<DataStore>; get(): Data; async update(fn: (d: Data) => void): Promise<void> }`.
  - Persisted at `<dataDir>/graph-manager.json`, validated with zod on load.
  - Writes are atomic (`.tmp` + `rename`), with file mode `0o600`.
  - Updates are serialized through a promise chain.
- Schema, final for all later tasks:
  ```ts
  const dataSchema = z.object({
    sessionSecret: z.string(),                       // random 32 bytes hex, created on first open
    forges: z.object({
      github: z.object({ token: z.string(), login: z.string() }).optional(),
      gitlab: z.object({ token: z.string(), login: z.string(), baseUrl: z.string() }).optional(),
    }).default({}),
    prs: z.record(z.string(), z.object({ url: z.string(), number: z.number(), branch: z.string(), forge: z.enum(["github", "gitlab"]), createdAt: z.string() })).default({}),  // key: `${workspaceId}/${runId}`
  });
  ```

### CREATE `src/server/auth.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - Cookie `gm_session` = `<expiresMs>.<hmacSha256Hex(secret, expiresMs)>`, 30 days, `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict`, `Path=/`.
  - `verifySession(cookie, secret, now)` checks the HMAC with `timingSafeEqual` and the expiry.
  - Routes:
    - `POST /api/auth/login {password}`: compare with `timingSafeEqual` over SHA-256 digests. 204 + cookie on success; 401 `{error:"wrong password"}` otherwise.
    - `POST /api/auth/logout`: clears the cookie.
    - `GET /api/auth/me`: 200 `{ok:true}`.
  - An `onRequest` hook answers 401 `{error:"login required"}` when there is no valid session for every URL that starts with `/api/` (except `POST /api/auth/login`) and every URL matching `/runs/<ws>/<runId>/view` or `/runs/<ws>/<runId>/view/*` (the run-page proxy added later). Other `/runs/...` paths are SPA routes served by the index.html fallback, so a reload while logged out shows the login page. Export the predicate as `needsAuth(method, url)`. WebSocket upgrade requests go through the same hook. Later tasks serve terminals at `/api/terminals/:id/ws`.

### CREATE `src/server/workspaces.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  ```ts
  export interface Workspace { id: string; path: string; rel: string; forge: string; fullPath: string }
  // Workspaces live at <workspacesDir>/<forge>/<owner>/<repo> (GitLab groups may nest: <forge>/<group>/<sub>/<repo>).
  // A workspace is any directory up to 5 levels deep that contains `.git`; don't descend into one.
  // id = rel with "/" replaced by "~" (e.g. "github~octo~hello"); forge = first segment; fullPath = the rest joined by "/".
  export async function listWorkspaces(root: string): Promise<Workspace[]>
  export function resolveWorkspace(root: string, id: string): Workspace | undefined   // rejects "..", absolute, and ids whose dir has no .git
  export function insideWorkspaces(root: string, p: string): boolean                   // path.resolve + startsWith(root + sep)
  ```
- Skip `node_modules` and dot-directories during the walk.

### CREATE `src/server/app.ts` and `src/server/routes/health.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `export async function buildApp(config: Config, opts?: { store?: DataStore }): Promise<FastifyInstance>`.
  - Register `@fastify/cookie`, then `@fastify/websocket`, then the auth hook and routes.
  - `GET /api/health` returns `{ok:true}` (behind auth).
  - Every feature route module has the shape `export async function xRoutes(app: FastifyInstance, ctx: AppContext)` and is registered with one line in `buildApp`, under the comment `// feature routes (one line per feature)`.
  - `AppContext = { config: Config; store: DataStore }`, exported from `app.ts`. Later tasks may add optional fields.
  - If `dist/web` exists (`new URL("../web/", import.meta.url)` from `dist/server/app.js`), serve it with `@fastify/static`. Any GET that is not `/api/*`, not `/runs/*/view/*` and not a file falls back to `index.html`, for SPA routing.
  - Errors: zod failures become 400 `{error}`; unknown errors become 500 `{error:"internal error"}`, with the error logged.
- **GOTCHA**: Don't log request bodies. Tokens arrive in later tasks.

### CREATE the web UI

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - **`src/web/api.ts`**: `api<T>(path, init?)`. It is a fetch wrapper that sends JSON, throws `ApiError(status, error)`, and on 401 dispatches `window` event `gm:logout`.
  - **`App.tsx`**:
    - Checks `GET /api/auth/me`. Shows `<Login>` on 401, otherwise a shell with a left nav: **Workspaces** `/workspaces`, **Terminals** `/terminals`, **Runs** `/runs`, **Settings** `/settings`, plus a **Log out** button.
    - Routes with react-router `BrowserRouter`: `/` redirects to `/runs`; `/runs/:ws/:runId` is `RunDetail`.
  - **Pages**: each placeholder page exports a default component with an `<h1>` naming the page and `data-testid="page-<name>"`. Later tasks replace one file each.
  - **`Login.tsx`**: a password field, a **Log in** button, and an error text on 401.
  - **`styles.css`**: a plain, clean dark/light theme with CSS variables. No CSS framework.

### UPDATE root `eslint.config.js`

- **IMPLEMENT**: add `{ files: ["apps/graph-manager/src/web/**/*.{ts,tsx}"], languageOptions: { globals: { window: "readonly", document: "readonly", fetch: "readonly", location: "readonly", localStorage: "readonly", WebSocket: "readonly", EventSource: "readonly" } } }`, or use `globals.browser` if the `globals` package is already installed.
- Ignore `apps/graph-manager/dist/`; `**/dist/` may already cover it.

### CREATE tests

- **`src/server/auth.test.ts`**: `buildApp` with a temp `dataDir` and `password:"pw"`, then `app.inject`:
  - `GET /api/health` without a cookie gives 401.
  - Login with `"nope"` gives 401.
  - Login with `"pw"` gives 204 and a `set-cookie` with `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Strict`.
  - `GET /api/health` with that cookie gives 200.
  - A cookie with a changed HMAC gives 401.
  - After logout the cookie is cleared.
- **`src/server/config.test.ts`**: a missing `GM_PASSWORD` throws; the defaults apply.
- **`src/server/store.test.ts`**: the file is created with mode 600 (skip the mode check on win32); `update` persists; an invalid file throws.
- **`src/server/workspaces.test.ts`**: create `github/octo/hello/.git` and `gitlab/grp/sub/proj/.git` in a temp dir.
  - `listWorkspaces` returns ids `github~octo~hello` and `gitlab~grp~sub~proj` with the right forge and fullPath.
  - `resolveWorkspace(root, "..~x")` is undefined.
- **`src/web/Login.test.tsx`** (`// @vitest-environment jsdom`): renders the login form; a submit with a mocked fetch returning 401 shows the error text.

### UPDATE `TESTING.md` (root): append a "graph-manager" section

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  ```bash
  npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run build -w graph-manager
  GM_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
  GM_PASSWORD=pw GM_PORT=7420 GM_DATA_DIR=$GM_DIR/data GM_WORKSPACES_DIR=$GM_DIR/ws node apps/graph-manager/dist/server/main.js &
  curl -s -c $GM_DIR/c -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"password":"pw"}' http://127.0.0.1:7420/api/auth/login
  curl -s -b $GM_DIR/c http://127.0.0.1:7420/api/health      # {"ok":true}
  ```
- Then: "Open http://127.0.0.1:7420/ with agent-browser, log in with `pw`, and look at each page." Note that later sections cover forges (fake forge), terminals and runs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npm run build -w graph-manager` produces `apps/graph-manager/dist/server/main.js` and `apps/graph-manager/dist/web/index.html`.
- [ ] `GM_PASSWORD=pw node apps/graph-manager/dist/server/main.js` serves the UI on 127.0.0.1:7420. Without `GM_PASSWORD` it exits 1 with `GM_PASSWORD is required`.
- [ ] Every `/api/*` and `/runs/*/*/view*` request without a valid session gets 401. Login and logout work as described.
- [ ] The UI shows the login page, then a shell with four nav entries and placeholder pages. A deep link to `/settings` works after a reload (SPA fallback).
- [ ] Root `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass and include graph-manager's tests.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager
npm run build -w graph-manager && GM_PASSWORD=pw GM_DATA_DIR=$(mktemp -d) GM_WORKSPACES_DIR=$(mktemp -d) timeout 5 node apps/graph-manager/dist/server/main.js; echo exit=$?
```
